1: ## 1. libs/schemas
2: 
3: - [x] 1.1 Update Task schema: add status (enum pending|processing|completed),
4:       meta (optional)
5: - [x] 1.2 Redefine Result.Api as independent schema: id, tags, link, meta, data,
6:       created_at, updated_at, task_id; remove by and extend from Task
7: 
8: ## 2. libs/api – Decouple and abstractions
9: 
10: - [x] 2.1 Remove @ecrawler/server from libs/api package.json dependencies
11: - [x] 2.2 Define Auth as Context.Tag in libs/api (e.g. api/auth.ts)
12: - [x] 2.3 Define UnknownError in libs/api (e.g. api/error.ts)
13: - [x] 2.4 Update collector and dispatcher groups to use Auth from libs/api
14:       (remove server imports)
15: - [x] 2.5 Update dispatcher group to use UnknownError from libs/api
16: 
17: ## 3. libs/api – Payloads and success types
18: 
19: - [x] 3.1 Add meta (optional) to CreateTask, CreateResult, UpdateTask,
20:       UpdateResult payloads
21: - [x] 3.2 Remove by from CreateResult, UpdateResult, NextPayload, Result
22:       QueryParams
23: - [x] 3.3 Update TaskApi success types to use new Task schema (getTasks,
24:       updateTask, nextTask)
25: - [x] 3.4 Update ResultApi success types to use new Result schema (getResults,
26:       createResult)
27: 
28: ## 4. Server – Database and infrastructure
29: 
30: - [x] 4.1 Fix Database layer: ensure Database.service provides
31:       EffectPgDatabase<Schemas>; fix main.ts to use Database.layer
32: - [x] 4.2 Create pg-tags.ts with tagsContained/tagsContains using PostgreSQL
33:       array operators
34: - [x] 4.3 Implement Auth.layer in server that validates token via Database;
35:       export for main composition
36: - [x] 4.4 Implement MaxBodySize middleware (1 MB limit, 413 on exceed); add to
37:       API middleware stack
38: 
39: ## 5. Server – Handlers
40: 
41: - [x] 5.1 Update root.ts imports: Database from services, schema from
42:       database/schemas; remove client, sqlite-tags
43: - [x] 5.2 Update collector handlers: use schema.results columns (no by); persist
44:       meta from payload
45: - [x] 5.3 Update dispatcher handlers: use schema.tasks columns (no by); persist
46:       meta from payload
47: - [x] 5.4 Update nextTask: select pending, set status to processing, return
48:       task; remove by logic
49: - [x] 5.5 Update main.ts: compose API with Auth.layer, Database.layer,
50:       MaxBodySize
51: 
52: ## 6. Worker
53: 
54: - [x] 6.1 Update worker Client and types to use new Task/Result shapes
55: - [x] 6.2 Remove by from CreateResult and NextPayload calls in worker
